name: Brasero
summary: Brasero does not allow contributions generated entirely by LLMs or chatbots, and applies its AI-generated-content ban to code, documentation, issues and artwork. It excepts pure translation of issue and comment text into English; using AI to answer questions or find information is allowed but discouraged, and support is not provided for anything referencing AI output.

evidence.quote: This project does not allow contributions generated entirely by large languages models (LLMs) and chatbots. This ban includes, but is not limited to, tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, DeepSeek, and Devin AI.
This ban of AI generated content applies to all parts of the projects, including, but not limited to, code, documentation, issues, and artworks.
An exception applies for purely translating texts for issues and comments to English.

AI tools can be used to answer questions and find information. However, we encourage contributors to avoid them in favor of using [existing documentation](https://developer.gnome.org) and our [chats and forums](https://welcome.gnome.org).
